execution_contract: One generic helper_<address> CPU engine takes RecordContext<M,E> where M implements canonical GuestAddressSpace. No native address casts or retained calls occur in the engine. HalfwordOutput is a closed guest-address or borrowed-local destination and preserves the original write points.
root_bridge: Root integration owns native C ABI exports and context construction. It wraps guest output addresses in HalfwordOutput::Guest. Actual Rust local halfwords use HalfwordOutput::Local.

memory.local_frames: 747584 uses an admitted four-byte canonical GuestStack frame; 74831c uses an admitted eight-byte canonical GuestStack frame. Neither frame is initialized by the caller.

instruction_corrections: 74b5fc runtime channel selector stride is six bytes per bank, not two bytes per selector.

747604 selects the nearest of three signed profile reference values; ties retain the earlier reference. The selected byte factor is capped at 240 before signed multiplication and truncating division by 240.
74b05c independently selects low and high calibration margin keys, adjusts signed 16-bit endpoints, clips them against original endpoints plus margins, and maps both endpoints through 74947c.
7472ec and 74b044 actually return zero without writing memory in the installed instructions. Their zero results are not replacement acknowledgments.
7492ac stores the unbounded converted sample before applying the optional configuration cap and requested bounds. Bounds compare as unsigned words after signed 16-bit extension.
749430 multiplies in wrapping 32-bit arithmetic and returns the low 16 bits of an unsigned quotient. A zero scale divisor is changed to one.
verification: Source-only implementation. No builds, tests, formatters, native runs, SDK runs, guest execution, or camera operations performed.
